mentions.name: ActiveJournal
mentions.description: An augmented journaling app that helps users better understand how their mind works by identifying mental patterns and deciding to break or modify them, grounded in research.
mentions.problem: People lack a way to build an operating manual for how their mind works and to identify patterns they want to break or modify.
